answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The fable of work and the nadir of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a ember to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
